summary: Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd, a Taiwanese foreign private issuer, disclosed via Form 6-K that on October 8, 2026 its Indonesian subsidiary signed a conditional land sale and purchase agreement with an unaffiliated third-party seller for approximately seven hectares in West Java, Indonesia. Consideration plus electricity connection fee reimbursement totals roughly US$30-40 million in Indonesian rupiah, payable in stages. The HGB-titled land supports planned AI/high-performance computing and data center development. Final transfer deed targeted on or before January 31, 2027, subject to due diligence, title extension, utility transfer, interconnection and financing conditions.
